global: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glistens in a floral-patterned bowl, topped with chashu pork, spinach, and sliced green onions. The warm, inviting lighting highlights the rich red broth against a soft pink tablecloth.

regions.background: Light pink tray with smooth, slightly textured surface, oval shape, visible edges, and subtle creases.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, green onions, spinach, and a slice of orange, all submerged in rich, reddish-brown liquid.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: glossy brown, tender-looking slice with visible marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface texture.
